item.title: OnCorps AI: Former BlackRock Executive Ron Allen Named As CEO
item.description: OnCorps AI, an agentic AI platform focused on fund operations, has appointed former BlackRock executive Ron Allen as Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately. Founder Bob Suh will transition to Chairman and will remain involved in shaping product direction and supporting the company’s strategic growth. item.description: The U.S. Small Business Administration announced its 7(a) Working Capital Pilot (WCP) Program has generated more than $150 million in new lending since the program began, with more than $125 million of that total approved since President Trump took office last January. item.title: RTX To Invest $139 Million In Singapore Through New EDB MOUs
